what: The main asteroid belt as dots placed at random inside the belt's spread, in distance from the Sun and in angle above or below the ecliptic, measured along the whole orbits of JPL's main-belt asteroids (class MBA) of absolute magnitude 13 or brighter. Not individual asteroids, and the same on every date.
frame: ecliptic and equinox of J2000, centred on the Sun, the orrery's drawing frame
rounding: each coordinate to 0.001 AU, about 150,000 km: a drawing, not a measurement
